0.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_000010_ALISAIE
0.description: Ah, there you are. You're just in time to welcome our guest...

1.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_000020_EMETSELCH
1.description: Please. Did I not explicitly tell you that we would be meeting again soon?

2.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_000030_EMETSELCH
2.description: Lest you forget, I made you a promise. I have no intention of meddling with your mission. I come only to observe.

3.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_000040_EMETSELCH
3.description: Your Exarch friend in particular has piqued my curiosity. Summoning you all like that. Most impressive.

4.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_000050_THANCRED
4.description: You honestly expect us to believe you've come only to observe? Or that you might deign to lift a finger to aid our cause if called upon?

5.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_000060_THANCRED
5.description: Even if there were a sliver of truth in your words, I would never accept your help. Not in my darkest hour─not after all the suffering your kind has wrought.

6.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_000070_EMETSELCH
6.description: So petty. I meant what I said and I said what I meant.

7.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_000080_EMETSELCH
7.description: Wage your war against the sin eaters. Put each and every Lightwarden to the sword.

8.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_000090_EMETSELCH
8.description: Prove yourselves heroes brave and true, and I will be glad to embrace you as allies.

9.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_000100_EMETSELCH
9.description: Allies worthy of bearing the burden of truth.

10.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_000110_EMETSELCH
10.description: Surely such a partnership would be preferable to yet another round of fisticuffs?

11.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_000120_EMETSELCH
11.description: ...And thus did the olive branch wither and die. Pity.

12.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_000130_EMETSELCH
12.description: Well─let no man say I did not try, futile as it was.

13.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_000140_EMETSELCH
13.description: Though I suspect you will seek me out when you grow tired of making the same mistakes.

14.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_000150_EMETSELCH
14.description: Difficult decisions lie ahead of you. Decisions best made with the benefit of knowledge to which only the eternal are privy.

15.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_000160_EMETSELCH
15.description: For now, I shall resume my shadowy vigil. Whatever you choose to do, make sure it's worth watching, would you.

17.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_000180_THANCRED
17.description: A vain attempt to make us doubt our chosen course, most like. As if we'd believe a word that passed his lips.

18.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_000190_THANCRED
18.description: Unless you think there is some truth in what he says?

22.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_A1_000_003_NONE_VOICE
22.description: I don't know. But if he crosses us, I'll make him wish he hadn't.

23.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_000200_ALPHINAUD
23.description: If he simply meant to lead us astray, he could have done so without revealing himself. At least, not in the manner he did.

24.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_000210_ALPHINAUD
24.description: I share your suspicion, of course. But if he simply meant to lead us astray, he could have done so without revealing himself. At least, not in the manner he did.

25.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_000220_ALPHINAUD
25.description: I am sure you will. But consider for a moment: if he meant simply to lead us astray, he could have done so without revealing himself. At least, not in the manner he did.

26.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_000230_ALPHINAUD
26.description: It goes without saying that an alliance with the Ascians is out of the question. But since we have no way of knowing where they might be hiding, it seems only logical to press on with our mission─even if our enemy seems content for it to succeed.

27.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_000240_MYSTERYVOICE
27.description: Then let us discuss the sin eaters.

28.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_000250_MYSTERYVOICE
28.description: I would begin by thanking you all for your efforts thus far.

29.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_000260_MYSTERYVOICE
29.description: In striking down the Lightwardens of Lakeland and Il Mheg, you have accomplished more in your short time here than all of our forces managed in the last century.

30.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_000270_THANCRED
30.description: That may be, but the Wardens of Kholusia, Amh Araeng, and Rak'tika remain.

31.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_000280_MYSTERYVOICE
31.description: Indeed. And their precise whereabouts are as yet unknown.

32.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_000290_MYSTERYVOICE
32.description: Which is why I propose we divide our forces and conduct a systematic survey of each region. Once we have found our quarry, we may then determine how best to proceed.

33.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_000300_ALISAIE
33.description: I'll take Amh Araeng, in that case. I know the lie of the land well enough.

34.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_000310_ALPHINAUD
34.description: If there are no objections, I will make for Kholusia. I have connections there both in and around Eulmore that may prove useful.

35.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_000320_MYSTERYVOICE
35.description: Then I would ask that you journey to Rak'tika.

36.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_000330_MYSTERYVOICE
36.description: There you will find Y'shtola. With her assistance, I doubt the Warden will evade your grasp for long.

37.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_000340_RYNE
37.description: Is Y'shtola the conjurer you and Urianger used to talk about?

38.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_000350_THANCRED
38.description: That's right. Though we haven't spoken much since she left for the forest.

39.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_000360_MYSTERYVOICE
39.description: I fear I may be to blame for that. I had every intention of relaying the news of your arrival, but she is...disinclined to speak with me.

40.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_000370_MYSTERYVOICE
40.description: You have visited her, have you not? Might I trouble you to...?

42.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_000390_MYSTERYVOICE
42.description: My thanks. While you are all out in the field, I shall be here attending to business. I had somewhat fancifully contemplated joining the search myself, but other matters demand my attention.

44.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_000410_MYSTERYVOICE
44.description: A missive from Lord Vauthry. He invites me to join him in Eulmore to discuss the recent conflict at Lydha Lran.

45.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_000420_ALISAIE
45.description: And? Did he even bother to offer any bait? It's obviously a trap.

46.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_000430_MYSTERYVOICE
46.description: I should be surprised if it were not. Nevertheless, I must seize this opportunity to speak with him, even if only a few words are exchanged.

47.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_000440_MYSTERYVOICE
47.description: Though my power will be much diminished so far from the tower, it is a risk I am willing to take.

48.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_000450_MYSTERYVOICE
48.description: Master Alphinaud─might I impose upon you to accompany me to Eulmore, prior to beginning your reconnaissance?

50.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_000470_MYSTERYVOICE
50.description: Then let us make ready. Safe travels to you all.

51.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_000480_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
51.description: No matter how far he goes, man cannot resist looking back on the path he has walked.

52.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_000490_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
52.description: The untold stories and secrets of the past can be more alluring than the promise of tomorrow.

53.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_000500_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
53.description: And so he braves the forests of Rak'tika in search of mystery and wonder...

54.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_000510_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
54.description: Of Ronka, to which all seekers of hidden truths are inevitably drawn...

56.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_000530_URIANGER
56.description: Vast though these woods may be, they are, by and large, uninhabitable.

57.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_000540_URIANGER
57.description: Not so the swamps of Citia, however, whose sparse foliage permitted man a foothold.

58.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_000550_EMETSELCH
58.description: "No lands must remain beyond our grasp. Go forth. Conquer. Rule.“

59.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_000560_EMETSELCH
59.description: Forgive me. A sudden pang of nostalgia for those halcyon days.

60.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_000570_EMETSELCH
60.description: Exploring virgin territories, subjugating primitive peoples. All for the glory of Garlemald!

61.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_000580_THANCRED
61.description: If you've brought your ivory standard, I'll be happy to tell you where to stick it.

62.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_000590_EMETSELCH
62.description: Can we not simply take a moment to enjoy the view together? Or would you rather I spied on you from the shadows?

63.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_000600_EMETSELCH
63.description: Much more of this, and I may very well begin to regret my show of good faith.

64.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_000610_RYNE
64.description: If...if you really want to stay, then help us fight.

65.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_000620_EMETSELCH
65.description: Mmm... No, I think not. I am an observer─nothing more.

66.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_000630_EMETSELCH
66.description: Even shielded by the shadows of these boughs, I feel the Light's presence most keenly.

67.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_000640_EMETSELCH
67.description: To accompany you is taxing enough. To fight is out of the question.

68.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_000650_THANCRED
68.description: I will suffer your company if I must, but not your commentary.

69.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_000660_URIANGER
69.description: I see little sign of recent activity, nor hath any meaningful progress been made with the reconstruction...

70.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_000670_URIANGER
70.description: Mayhap Y'shtola sought shelter elsewhere. Come, let us quit this place.

72.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_000690_RUNAR
72.description: (-Blessed Leader-)These sin eaters─they are not like the others!

73.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_000700_THANCRED
73.description: There's a reason for that. Lower your weapons, please. We mean you no harm.

74.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_000710_PEOPLEOFNIGHTA
74.description: How is it they can speak!?

75.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_000720_PEOPLEOFNIGHTB
75.description: It's a sin eater trick! They mean to kill us all!

81.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_000740_THANCRED
81.description: ...That will seem a lot less amusing when we are forced to kill them.

83.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_000760_EMETSELCH
83.description: I had hoped that by accompanying you, we might come to understand one another, but all I have come to understand is that you have a knack for inflaming the natives.

84.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_000770_EMETSELCH
84.description: You've committed the cardinal sin of <hex:021A020203>boring<hex:021A020103> me. And so I retire to the shade.

86.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_000790_PEOPLEOFNIGHTA
86.description: There! Did you see that one disappear!?

91.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_000840_RUNAR
91.description: We apprehended them as you ordered, but...are you certain these are sin eaters?

92.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_000850_YSHTOLA
92.description: The intense light of the aether I saw was unmistakable. If not sin eaters, then what?

93.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_000860_URIANGER
93.description: 'Tis passing queer that Y'shtola should mistake us for the enemy, is it not?

94.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_000870_URIANGER
94.description: Mayhap it hath been too long since last she beheld the radiance of thine aether...

95.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_000880_URIANGER
95.description: Master Matoya. Hath time truly made strangers of us?

96.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_000890_YSHTOLA
96.description: Nay. I recognize you, Urianger, Thancred. And this is Minfilia of the First, of whom you spoke before.

97.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_000900_URIANGER
97.description: Just so. And knowing as thou must that we come in peace, might I prevail upon thee to have thy comrades lower their arms?

98.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_000910_YSHTOLA
98.description: First explain this other presence in your company. The one I know not.

99.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_000920_YSHTOLA
99.description: There is but one manner of creature in this world whose aether is suffused with such an abundance of light.

100.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_000930_URIANGER
100.description: Mine apologies, Master Matoya, but thou art mistaken. Before thee standeth our dearest comrade. The truest hero among us.

101.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_000940_URIANGER
101.description: Though he is but recently arrived here in the First, not one but <hex:021A020203>two<hex:021A020103> Lightwardens have already perished by his most puissant hand.

102.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_000950_URIANGER
102.description: Though she is but recently arrived here in the First, not one but <hex:021A020203>two<hex:021A020103> Lightwardens have already perished by her most puissant hand.

106.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_A3_000_002_NONE_VOICE
106.description: Nice to see you too...“Master Matoya.”

107.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_A3_000_003_NONE_VOICE
107.description: You truly thought me a sin eater?

111.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_001000_YSHTOLA
111.description: Come, I would give you a proper introduction to Rak'tika and its people.

112.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_001010_YSHTOLA
112.description: Slitherbough is the largest of the Blessed's settlements.

113.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_001020_YSHTOLA
113.description: They worship no gods, instead revering Darkness itself.

114.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_001030_YSHTOLA
114.description: It is a curious kind of faith, but one which has granted them the strength to persevere in the wake of the Flood.

115.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_001040_YSHTOLA
115.description: I hope you weren't expecting a grand feast by way of welcome. They are a simple people.

116.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_001050_YSHTOLA
116.description: Now, I would hear of your travels away from prying ears. Come.

117.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_001060_YSHTOLA
117.description: I see. And now you seek the Lightwarden of Rak'tika.

118.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_001070_YSHTOLA
118.description: In the days after I arrived in the First, I too relied upon the Crystal Exarch for guidance. But his penchant for secrecy and the telling of half-truths soon lost him my trust. And thus did I strike out on my own.

119.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_001080_YSHTOLA
119.description: My work eventually led me here to the forest, which I have come to know like the back of my hand.

120.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_001090_YSHTOLA
120.description: I cannot say with certainty where your quarry is hiding, but I am confident I can narrow the search.

122.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_001110_YSHTOLA
122.description: Some few thousand years ago, this forest stood at the heart of the empire of Ronka.

123.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_001120_YSHTOLA
123.description: A great many relics of that civilization can still be found to the east in Yx'Maja.

124.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_001130_YSHTOLA
124.description: Or rather, <hex:021A020203>could<hex:021A020103> be found─were the area not fiercely guarded.

125.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_001140_YSHTOLA
125.description: Yx'Maja, you see, is home to a tribe of warriors whose lineage is said to date back to the time of the empire. Any attempt to enter their territory is met with lethal force. They offer no warnings, and suffer no trespasser to escape.

126.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_001150_YSHTOLA
126.description: Needless to say, my every attempt to survey the area has been thwarted.

127.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_001160_URIANGER
127.description: Mayhap the Warden hideth there full knowing none may approach it for fear of these protectors.

129.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_001180_YSHTOLA
129.description: I find the timing of its discovery suspiciously convenient. If I did not know better, I would think someone was trying to curry favor with me.

130.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_001190_YSHTOLA
130.description: Regardless, it will take time to decipher these writings. Yet I would not be at all surprised if they somehow held the key to entering Yx'Maja unmolested. The Exarch has a nose for serendipity.

131.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_001200_URIANGER
131.description: If there is aught I can do to assist thee in unraveling their secrets, thou need'st only ask.

132.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_001210_YSHTOLA
132.description: Thank you, Urianger. I may well take you up on that offer.

133.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_001220_YSHTOLA
133.description: While we set to work, might I suggest you take a tour of the city?

134.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_001230_YSHTOLA
134.description: Should you be in any doubt as to the importance of your role as the “Warrior of Darkness,” the people here will surely cure you of it.

135.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_001240_THANCRED
135.description: I must say, Y'shtola...while most of us have struggled to come to terms with our altered circumstances, you seem to have adapted rather well.

136.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_001250_YSHTOLA
136.description: Lest you forget, Master Matoya and I dedicated our lives to uncovering the truth which hides at the heart of our world.

137.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_001260_YSHTOLA
137.description: Though separate, the fate of this reflection is nevertheless bound to that of our home. That I would be daunted by such an invaluable opportunity is absurd.

138.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_001270_YSHTOLA
138.description: But what of you, Thancred? Could it be that you are still struggling to “come to terms” with the nature of your young companion?

139.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_001280_THANCRED
139.description: My “struggles” are none of your concern. Quite why you would speak thus─and in <hex:021A020203>this<hex:021A020103> company─I do not know. Perhaps you left more of yourself back in the Source than I assumed. If you'll excuse me.

140.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_001290_RYNE
140.description: He understands that I'm not the same. That I'm not her.

141.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_001300_YSHTOLA
141.description: Understands, perhaps, but does not accept. The question being whether he ever will.

142.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_001310_YSHTOLA
142.description: And whether <hex:021A020203>you<hex:021A020103> will, more importantly. As difficult as your circumstances may be, they are yours, not his. 'Tis you and you alone who bears ultimate responsibility for your life.

143.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_001320_YSHTOLA
143.description: But you need not make any hard choices now. Why not go and get some fresh air─clear your head?

144.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_001330_YSHTOLA
144.description: It seemed only right that we show our faces. May we join you?

146.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_001350_RUNAR
146.description: I thank you all for coming to pay respects to our fallen daughter of the night. In the light, she was known as Toddia. But in the dark, we shall remember her always as Minnine. Let us each take a moment to offer her our prayers.

147.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_001360_RUNAR
147.description: We entrust her now to the night's sweet embrace.

148.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_001370_RUNAR
148.description: In Darkness will she be free from pain and suffering, now and forevermore.

149.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_001380_RUNAR
149.description: May her soul find peace in the sunless sea of heaven, and in the love we bear for her in our hearts.

150.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_001390_YSHTOLA
150.description: That vessel represents the night sky. The “sunless sea of heaven.”

151.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_001400_RUNAR
151.description: We call upon you now, O Bringer of Shadow, to lead this gentle soul unto the sea. We call upon you, O Warrior of Darkness, to deliver her unto paradise everlasting.

152.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_001410_YSHTOLA
152.description: I am told you assisted in the preparations for the service. On behalf of the Blessed, you have my sincerest thanks.

153.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_001420_YSHTOLA
153.description: The enduring legend of the Warrior of Darkness owes much to the traditions of these people.

154.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_001430_YSHTOLA
154.description: And none were more ardent in their faith than Toddia. She would have been greatly moved by your presence.

156.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_A4_000_001_NONE_VOICE
156.description: I should like to have met her.

157.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_A4_000_002_NONE_VOICE
157.description: You know I don't deserve such reverence.

159.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_001440_RYNE
159.description: You might not deliver her to the heavens, but if you could deliver the night sky to her people─the <hex:021A020203>real<hex:021A020103> night sky─it would be the next best thing.

160.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_001450_RYNE
160.description: Their prayers would finally be answered. They could gaze up at the firmament and see their ancestors in every twinkle of the stars.

161.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_001460_RYNE
161.description: We cannot allow their hopes and dreams to drown in the light. We have to bring back the dark. If we don't, who will?

162.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_001470_RYNE
162.description: Forgive me. Thinking of all those we have lost, I...

163.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_001480_THANCRED
163.description: No, it's all right. We <hex:021A020203>will<hex:021A020103> bring back the dark.

164.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_001490_YSHTOLA
164.description: Mayhap sooner than later, in fact.

165.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_001500_YSHTOLA
165.description: Urianger and I have finished deciphering the tablet, and its contents were most illuminating. Let us reconvene in my chambers. We have much to discuss.

166.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_001510_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
166.description: These paintings...they seem familiar. Depictions of heroes throughout history. The age of gods... The empire of Ronka... And this...

167.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_001520_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
167.description: There was a man. A researcher who pored over these pieces...

168.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_001530_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
168.description: He offered us work when we needed it. Slaying beasts, delivering provisions... A funny old bugger, he was, but he had a good heart.

169.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_001540_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
169.description: He believed this first painting dated back to a time of myth and legends. A tribute to the heroes of a long-forgotten era.

170.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_001550_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
170.description: The story went that it was rediscovered by an explorer from Ronka, who was so struck by its majesty that a second painting was commissioned, commemorating the heroes of their day.

171.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_001560_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
171.description: "One day, you will all be here too,“ he said. ”Heroes immortalized forever. Maybe I'll paint you myself!“

172.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_001570_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
172.description: I had a good laugh at that. We were only trying to make our way, after all. Being heroes couldn't have been further from our minds.

173.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_001580_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
173.description: But it seems...he actually went and did it. Before or after the Flood, I wonder...

174.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_001590_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
174.description: Rather faded, isn't it, compared to the others. Or did someone try to scrape it off the wall? Maybe the man himself, once he came to his senses...

175.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_001600_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
175.description: Do you suppose your deeds will warrant an addition to this collection? Or some other kind of monument?

176.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_001610_YSHTOLA
176.description: There you are. I have everything I need. Let us quit this place.

177.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_001620_YSHTOLA
177.description: Is something the matter? We should go. The others are waiting.

179.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_001640_RUNAR
179.description: The others on patrol should have returned by now. Our food will be overcooked if we wait any longer.

180.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_001650_RUNAR
180.description: We will just have to start without them. Would you call Master Matoya and the others?

181.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_001660_YSHTOLA
181.description: I tire of these games, Urianger. Why do you pretend you cannot see it!?

182.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_001670_YSHTOLA
182.description: The blessing may spare <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468696D03> the fate of becoming a Lightwarden...

183.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_001680_YSHTOLA
183.description: But you cannot be blind to the nascent corruption! <hex:02080CE905FF04536865FF03486503> is not as <hex:02080CE905FF04736865FF03686503> was in the Source.

184.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_001690_YSHTOLA
184.description: Though I have no proof, I fear that the light which poured forth from the Wardens was not negated at all.

185.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_001700_YSHTOLA
185.description: I fear it was <hex:021A020203>absorbed<hex:021A020103>─that <hex:02080CE905FF04736865FF03686503> has been suffused with their light.

186.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_001710_URIANGER
186.description: Though I have given thought to this possibility, I dare not speak until more is known.

188.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_001730_YSHTOLA
188.description: By the time you deign to enlighten us, it may be too late─if it is not already.

189.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_001740_YSHTOLA
189.description: Urianger─I know full well, after all these years, that you have only the best of intentions.

190.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_001750_YSHTOLA
190.description: But that does not make it any easier to put my faith in a man so infatuated with secrecy.

191.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_001760_YSHTOLA
191.description: I have had my suspicions ever since the Exarch bade you speak that day, but now I must ask.

192.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_001770_YSHTOLA
192.description: The Eighth Umbral Calamity and all that followed; everything you claimed to have seen─did you?

194.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_001790_PEOPLEOFNIGHTA
194.description: The Eulmorans have come for us! We're under attack!

196.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_001810_MYSTERYVOICE
196.description: Lord Vauthry, how good it is to see you. How long has it been? Not since your inauguration, unless I am mistaken? Too long, at any rate. May I say how humbled I am to be invited not only into your city, but your home. You are as generous as ever.

198.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_001830_VAUTHRY
198.description: Let us dispense with the pleasantries. This merry band of dissidents people are calling “Warriors of Darkness”... They have slain sin eaters, and by all accounts the Crystarium is complicit in their villainy.

199.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_001840_VAUTHRY
199.description: And now I hear reports of your people obstructing my soldiers. So I must ask: what exactly do you think you are doing?

200.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_001850_MYSTERYVOICE
200.description: I might ask you the same thing. It should be clear even to you that defeating the Lightwardens represents the world's only hope of survival.

201.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_001860_MYSTERYVOICE
201.description: Even now, the people of Lakeland and Il Mheg rejoice in the return of night.

202.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_001870_MYSTERYVOICE
202.description: For a hundred years, they yearned for a means to fight back against the sin eaters and at last they have found one. Yet you choose to stand idly by and do nothing. Why?

203.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_001880_VAUTHRY
203.description: Why? Because this “hope” you cling to is nothing more than a fever dream. An exercise in futility.

204.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_001890_VAUTHRY
204.description: Even should you slay the sin eaters, the world as we know it is beyond salvation.

205.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_001900_VAUTHRY
205.description: With what little land and resources remain, the people would be free only to starve.

206.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_001910_VAUTHRY
206.description: Before long they would turn to violence, then to war, and ultimately usher themselves unto oblivion.

207.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_001920_VAUTHRY
207.description: They require a firm hand to shepherd them from the edge. The hand of a king─nay, a god!

208.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_001930_VAUTHRY
208.description: I will see their dreams fulfilled, their wishes granted. I will give them peace, order─and they shall never want for bliss.

209.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_001940_VAUTHRY
209.description: Men are fickle creatures who entertain vague ideals without the faintest notion what they cost. But a little fear can go a long way towards helping them realize what it is they truly need.

210.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_001950_VAUTHRY
210.description: <hex:021A020203>Sanctuary<hex:021A020103>. And they shall find none in this world, save that which <hex:021A020203>I<hex:021A020103> afford them.

211.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_001960_VAUTHRY
211.description: That is why the sin eaters exist. To unite the world under <hex:021A020203>my<hex:021A020103> dominion!

212.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_001970_MYSTERYVOICE
212.description: A paradise fit to grace the Eighth Umbral Era.

215.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_002000_MYSTERYVOICE
215.description: You have always held sway over those around you. Those who defy you must submit or die. What sits before me is the inevitable result of bloated privilege and unchecked power.

216.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_002010_MYSTERYVOICE
216.description: But man is more resilient than you think.

217.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_002020_MYSTERYVOICE
217.description: His achievements are not the product of violence and bloodshed but compassion and understanding.

218.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_002030_MYSTERYVOICE
218.description: This calamity is but another crisis to be overcome. And we will─once we eliminate the sin eaters.

219.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_002040_VAUTHRY
219.description: You poor, deluded fool. These people care not for the morrow. They care only for the now, and the contentment they lack. What good is a paradise to them if it is a thousand years in the making? Or even a hundred!?

220.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_002050_MYSTERYVOICE
220.description: You underestimate them, Lord Vauthry. They see further than you think. I have beheld it in the blood and sweat and tears of those who would sacrifice everything for a future they may never know. That their children may never know.

221.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_002060_MYSTERYVOICE
221.description: I have beheld it in the hopes and dreams of those who came before, which we bequeath to those who come after, that they might in turn build upon the foundations laid by our forebears.

222.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_002070_MYSTERYVOICE
222.description: <hex:021A020203>These<hex:021A020103> are the bonds which hold man and his world together, not your gilded chains─and I will resist your every effort to shackle him.

223.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_002080_VAUTHRY
223.description: In summary, you will continue to support the villains hunting my sin eaters?

224.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_002090_MYSTERYVOICE
224.description: With tremendous enthusiasm, for I have faith in the future they would build.

226.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_002110_VAUTHRY
226.description: Fools, the lot of you! So naive! So <hex:021A020203>painfully<hex:021A020103> predictable!

227.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_002120_VAUTHRY
227.description: Did you imagine I did not know your mind? That I would wait until <hex:021A020203>after<hex:021A020103> this meeting to dispatch my forces!? Even as we speak, they march to the sin eaters' defense!

229.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_002140_VAUTHRY
229.description: The people of this world are mine to rule, mine to command...

232.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_002170_VAUTHRY
232.description: Insolent swine! I will not stand for this. Do you hear me!?

234.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_002190_RANJIT
234.description: You speak for the Night's Blessed?

237.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_002220_YSHTOLA
237.description: If you have come to parley, I must insist that you first return him to us.

238.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_002230_RANJIT
238.description: You are in no position to make demands.

239.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_002240_RANJIT
239.description: By Lord Vauthry's decree, Rak'tika now falls under the governance of Eulmore. You will henceforth answer to us.

241.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_002251_YSHTOLA
241.description: And the Children of the Everlasting Dark have acquiesced to this madness?

242.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_002260_RANJIT
242.description: We have reached an accord, yes.

243.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_002270_RANJIT
243.description: Too many times have the Night's Blessed shunned Eulmore's overtures of friendship. The risk that you harbor hostile intentions has grown too great to ignore.

244.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_002280_RANJIT
244.description: Therefore his lordship has claimed dominion over this forest, and bestowed executive authority upon the Children of the Everlasting Dark.

245.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_002290_EVERLASTINGDARKNESS
245.description: In his wisdom, Lord Vauthry has agreed to recognize ours as the only permissible expression of Dark worship─its one true faith.

246.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_002300_EVERLASTINGDARKNESS
246.description: You and your false creed are a blight on these woods! A foul, unholy corruption that must be cleansed.

247.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_002310_EVERLASTINGDARKNESS
247.description: Little wonder the Warrior of Darkness visits both Lakeland and Il Mheg, yet shuns Rak'tika. Your perverted teachings hold blessed shadow at bay!

248.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_002320_YSHTOLA
248.description: You have accepted the yoke of Eulmore to spite us, then? Fools. Darkness will never return to these skies while they hold sway.

249.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_002330_RANJIT
249.description: Those of you minded to obey his lordship are to make for Woven Oath with all haste. We will leave you, that you may have time to prepare.

250.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_002340_RUNAR
250.description: Woven Oath!? Are you suggesting we abandon our faith to join those zealots!?

251.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_002350_EVERLASTINGDARKNESS
251.description: What has your “faith” afforded you thus far? Nothing! <hex:021A020203>We<hex:021A020103> will guide you along the righteous path.

253.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_002370_RANJIT
253.description: Anyone found here upon our return will be considered a traitor to Eulmore, and dealt with as such.

254.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_002380_YSHTOLA
254.description: We will discuss these developments after I have tended to our casualty.

256.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_002400_ALMET
256.description: (-Bow-wielding Sentinel-)You trespass upon sacred ground. Begone!

257.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_002410_YSHTOLA
257.description: Wait! We did not come to─

260.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_002440_YSHTOLA
260.description: Stop! We mean you no harm!

262.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_002460_YSHTOLA
262.description: We are allies of the empire of Ronka. As is customary, we come bearing the seal of the emperor.

266.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_002500_CYMET
266.description: (-Staff-wielding Sentinel-)Then perhaps there is yet hope!

268.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_002520_ALMET
268.description: (-Bow-wielding Sentinel-)We acknowledge your seal, but we must be certain of its authenticity.

269.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_002530_ALMET
269.description: (-Bow-wielding Sentinel-)Follow the azure flowers to our village. There we will judge if you are friend or foe.

270.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_002540_UIMET
270.description: (-Spear-wielding Sentinel-)Try not to stray from the path, all right?

271.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_002550_YSHTOLA
271.description: "Follow the flowers...“ Would it kill them to escort us?

272.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_002560_YSHTOLA
272.description: But if it affords us an opportunity to investigate Yx'Maja...fine.

282.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_002660_EULMOREADJUTANT
282.description: How was I to know that that would happen!? It looked like any other part of the floor!

283.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_002670_EULMOREADJUTANT
283.description: ...Might now be an opportune time to strike a bargain?

284.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_002680_EULMOREADJUTANT
284.description: We poisoned a number of villagers in Slitherbough with a toxin brewed for us by the Children.

286.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_002700_EULMOREADJUTANT
286.description: I daresay you know how potent their concoctions are─and the futility of trying to counteract their effects.

287.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_002710_EULMOREADJUTANT
287.description: Now, now. Try anything here and we're all likely to fall.

288.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_002720_EULMOREADJUTANT
288.description: Eventually, someone will come to our rescue. Or yours. Promise us safe passage and we'll give you the antidote!

290.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_002740_RANJIT
290.description: We do not negotiate with the enemy. The villagers' lives are forfeit. As is yours...

302.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_002860_THANCRED
302.description: We delivered the antidote to Slitherbough, and from what we could gather on the way here, the Eulmorans have had the good manners to withdraw.

303.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_002870_THANCRED
303.description: Thank the gods they did, or we would never have made it here in time. I'm told we have Runar and his comrades to thank for keeping the soldiers occupied prior to their retreat.

304.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_002880_THANCRED
304.description: They were preparing to come for you and Y'shtola, it seems, when Runar rallied the villagers and pursued them out of Slitherbough.

307.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_002910_URIANGER
307.description: Yx'Maja, in the care of the Viis. Thou art safe now, friend. Pray, rest thee awhile longer.

308.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_002920_RUNAR
308.description: No...no, I am all right. Somewhat heavy of limb, perhaps, but otherwise well I assure you.

309.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_002930_RUNAR
309.description: I am glad to see you are all safe. When we realized where the soldiers were headed, we knew something had to be done.

310.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_002940_RUNAR
310.description: I...do not see Master Matoya. She was with you, yes? What happened to her?

312.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_A5_000_001_NONE_VOICE
312.description: I cannot say for certain─but it was she who secured the antidote.

313.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_A5_000_002_NONE_VOICE
313.description: She saved the Night's Blessed─albeit at a cost...

315.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_002950_RUNAR
315.description: Spare me your riddles and speak plain! Where is Master Matoya!?

316.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_002960_RUNAR
316.description: Well!? Say something! Where is Master Matoya!?

318.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_002980_RUNAR
318.description: Why would she do such a thing?

319.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_002990_RUNAR
319.description: Was there no other way? I...I cannot believe that she...that she...

320.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_003000_RUNAR
320.description: We must begin the search immediately! I will come with you!

321.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_003010_RUNAR
321.description: What are you waiting for? We must find her! She could be trapped or hurt or...

322.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_003020_RUNAR
322.description: She is alive. She is <hex:021A020203>alive<hex:021A020103>, damn you!

323.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_003030_ALMET
323.description: Forgive me for interrupting, but our scouts have apprehended an intruder.

324.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_003040_ALMET
324.description: We thought perhaps he might be an associate of yours...

326.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_003060_EMETSELCH
326.description: Well...this is embarrassing. In my defense, they are surprisingly tenacious.

327.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_003070_EMETSELCH
327.description: So─what trouble have you gotten yourselves into this time?

328.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_003080_EMETSELCH
328.description: Well, well. What an intriguing turn of events.

329.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_003090_EMETSELCH
329.description: My condolences, by the way. 'Tis never easy to lose the ones we love.

330.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_003100_EMETSELCH
330.description: Well, she is dead, isn't she? Wishing it were otherwise will not make it so.

331.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_003110_THANCRED
331.description: That <hex:021A020203>you<hex:021A020103> should be indifferent to her loss is no surprise. But to us, she was a friend. The best of friends.

332.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_003120_RYNE
332.description: You have something on your mind. What is it?

334.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_A6_000_001_NONE_VOICE
334.description: I'm beginning to wonder what really happened when she fell.

335.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_A6_000_002_NONE_VOICE
335.description: After she fell, there was a powerful gust of wind as if from nowhere...

336.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_003130_URIANGER
336.description: Pray recount to us again that which thou witnessed in the ruins, omitting not the slightest detail.

338.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_003150_THANCRED
338.description: The teleportation magick she used to spirit us away from Ul'dah after the bloody banquet! I recall a similar gale in the tunnel before it took effect.

339.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_003160_EMETSELCH
339.description: Interesting. I thought I sensed a brief disturbance in the Lifestream. How reassuring to know it was not my imagination.

340.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_003170_EMETSELCH
340.description: I felt it only once, I should mention. Which would suggest she is still adrift on its currents.

341.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_003180_URIANGER
341.description: Then I fear she may yet be lost to us─for it was only by the grace of the elementals that she was plucked from that great aetherial river.

342.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_003190_EMETSELCH
342.description: Oh...very well. I'll go and fetch her...

343.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_003200_EMETSELCH
343.description: Perhaps a clear and unambiguous act of kindness will serve to win the trust you seem so determined to deny me.

344.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_003210_EMETSELCH
344.description: Yes, this place should serve well enough.

345.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_003220_EMETSELCH
345.description: Might I have a little space? I <hex:021A020203>need<hex:021A020103> to concentrate.

346.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_003230_EMETSELCH
346.description: Now then...what color was her soul again?

348.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_003250_RUNAR
348.description: He─He's done it! He's brought her back!

351.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_003280_YSHTOLA
351.description: Yes... Though I cannot imagine how. What happened?

352.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_003290_URIANGER
352.description: Thou didst invoke the power of Flow, which thence did usher thy soul unto the Lifestream.

353.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_003300_YSHTOLA
353.description: I wanted to save the antidote, and after that...

355.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_003320_YSHTOLA
355.description: I did something exceedingly reckless. For which you will just have to forgive me.

357.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_003340_RUNAR
357.description: Master Matoya! Oh, thank the heavens you're all right!

358.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_003350_RUNAR
358.description: I had nearly given up hope.

359.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_003360_YSHTOLA
359.description: Please, Runar, dry your tears. What would the others think if they saw you like this?

360.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_003370_YSHTOLA
360.description: Come now─did you really think I would go gently into that dark night with so much left undone? So many mysteries left unsolved?

361.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_003380_EMETSELCH
361.description: Ahem. Is there aught you wish to say to me? A word of <hex:021A020203>thanks<hex:021A020103>, perhaps?

362.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_003390_URIANGER
362.description: Emet-Selch, the Ascian of whom I spoke. 'Twas he who plucked thee from the Lifestream.

364.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_003410_YSHTOLA
364.description: Thank you. Differences notwithstanding, you saved my life, and for that I am grateful.

365.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_003420_YSHTOLA
365.description: But let us turn our attention to more important matters, such as the Qitana Ravel.

366.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_003430_YSHTOLA
366.description: You had better not have explored its depths without me.

368.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_A7_000_001_NONE_VOICE
368.description: Heavens no. In fact, I was awaiting your return.

369.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_A7_000_002_NONE_VOICE
369.description: I wouldn't have known where to start.

370.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_A7_000_003_NONE_VOICE
370.description: I'll tell you after you've got some rest.

371.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_003440_THANCRED
371.description: Well. Almet and the others should be pleased to see you in such <hex:021A020203>uncharacteristically<hex:021A020103> high spirits. Let us return to Fanow, then, and discuss the coming expedition.

372.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_003450_RYNE
372.description: The Lightwarden is dead. The Blessed's prayers have been answered...

376.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_003490_YSHTOLA
376.description: It does. Though <hex:02080CE905FF04736865FF03686503> shows no immediate signs of corruption, the danger remains. <hex:02080CE905FF04536865FF03486503> must be told.

377.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_003500_YSHTOLA
377.description: ...Would you describe it to me, Urianger? Paint for me a picture with your words.

378.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_003510_URIANGER
378.description: A sea of shimmering stars. Diamonds strewn across a raven gown, boundless and beautiful.

379.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_003520_URIANGER
379.description: 'Tis an exquisite sight not unlike that of the Source. Calm and gentle...and forgiving...

381.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_003540_URIANGER
381.description: For however deep the void, or wide the expanse, there is no shore so distant as to be beyond the reach of light. ...Ominous though that may sound, given our present travails.

382.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_003550_YSHTOLA
382.description: Well fought. Let us return home.

383.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_003560_YSHTOLA
383.description: The murals. If I am not mistaken, they predate the empire.

385.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_003580_YSHTOLA
385.description: A peculiarity of the paint. Most are made from mineral-based pigments, but whatever was used here is older than anything I have ever seen.

386.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_003590_YSHTOLA
386.description: According to Almet, this sanctuary was built to preserve the wisdom of the ancients. What events do these murals commemorate, I wonder?

387.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_003600_EMETSELCH
387.description: Must you always linger after defeating your enemies? Navigating these halls on foot is exhausting.

388.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_003610_THANCRED
388.description: Come to lead us to safety, have you?

389.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_003620_EMETSELCH
389.description: Hmph! I was <hex:021A020203>bored<hex:021A020103>. But how is the hero of the hour?

390.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_003630_EMETSELCH
390.description: Hmm. Fighting fit, I see. Keep up the good work.

392.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_003650_EMETSELCH
392.description: Every hour of every day. But never you mind about that. As I have told you a thousand times before: I like to watch. Nothing more.

393.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_003660_EMETSELCH
393.description: Well! I would quit this place, and I suggest you do the same. There is yet work to be done.

394.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_003670_EMETSELCH
394.description: Ah...there is a sight to bring a tear to the eye.

396.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_003690_EMETSELCH
396.description: That I do. Indeed, there was a time when anyone and everyone would.

397.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_003700_EMETSELCH
397.description: Until one calamitous day when the world was divided across ten and three reflections, sundering the land and all who dwelled upon it.

398.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_003710_EMETSELCH
398.description: And the worst part? No one could remember it. Not really. Just fragments and fleeting memories of an achingly familiar world...

399.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_003720_EMETSELCH
399.description: A vision shared of a paradise lost, preserved only in song and scripture and paint...

400.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_003730_EMETSELCH
400.description: Once upon a time. Yet here we find ourselves again. To look, learn, and <hex:021A020203>remember<hex:021A020103>...

401.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_003740_YSHTOLA
401.description: Then share with us the stories you know so well. We are listening.

402.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_003750_EMETSELCH
402.description: Before the great sundering, there was one world. A world that knew naught but peace and prosperity.

403.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_003760_EMETSELCH
403.description: Until it was faced with a crisis. Unprecedented, terrifying. Civilization found itself perched upon a precipice, staring into oblivion.

404.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_003770_EMETSELCH
404.description: But through prayer and sacrifice, the will of the star was made manifest.

405.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_003780_EMETSELCH
405.description: Zodiark was His name, and by His grace was the calamity averted.

407.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_003800_EMETSELCH
407.description: A savior mighty and magnificent, deserving of reverence and gratitude...one would have thought. Yet some thought otherwise.

408.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_003810_EMETSELCH
408.description: From the fears of these naysayers would rise Hydaelyn─She who was to serve as His shackles. To bind Him and hold Him in check.

409.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_003820_EMETSELCH
409.description: And so they fought, and they fought, and they fought. And in the end...Hydaelyn was victorious.

410.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_003830_EMETSELCH
410.description: With all Her strength She smote Him─dealing a blow so devastating that it split the very fabric of reality. And thus was Zodiark banished and His being divided.

411.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_003840_EMETSELCH
411.description: That concludes today's lesson on long-forgotten history. Though I imagine your Mother would offer a rather contradictory account. As is Her wont.

412.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_003850_THANCRED
412.description: I'm sorry─I can only assume I misheard, but it sounded an awful lot like you were implying both Zodiark and Hydaelyn are not gods, but─

413.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_003860_EMETSELCH
413.description: What? Not gods of the First? Is that what you thought these paintings depicted? Or...? Oh! Ohhh...

414.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_003870_EMETSELCH
414.description: They are gods after a fashion, yes, but no different from the kind with which you are so intimately acquainted. Formed of faith and prayer, of conviction and devotion...

415.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_003880_EMETSELCH
415.description: The eldest and most powerful...of primals.

416.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_003890_YSHTOLA
416.description: You have spun quite a tale.

417.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_003900_YSHTOLA
417.description: Yet you have not explained the role of the Ascians in all of this. How is it you are privy to ancient secrets lost to time?

419.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_003910_EMETSELCH
419.description: Finally, <hex:021A020203>finally<hex:021A020103>, you ask the right question! And shrewd questions warrant honest answers...

420.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_003920_EMETSELCH
420.description: We Ascians know because it is our history. Our story.

421.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_003930_EMETSELCH
421.description: It was we who summoned Zodiark─we natives of that sundered paradise.

422.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_003940_EMETSELCH
422.description: Now do you see why we yearn for the Great Rejoining?

423.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_003950_EMETSELCH
423.description: For our world...for our people...for all creation to be made whole again.

424.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_003960_EMETSELCH
424.description: Wouldn't you wish for the same?

425.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_003970_RUNAR
425.description: Ah, you are returned! And none the worse for wear, I see.

426.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_003980_YSHTOLA
426.description: You needn't worry about us. What became of the Eulmoran soldiers, more importantly?

427.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_003990_RUNAR
427.description: They turned tail and fled at the sight of the night sky.

428.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_004000_RUNAR
428.description: The Children of the Everlasting Dark have also retreated back to Woven Oath.

429.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_004010_RUNAR
429.description: Try as they might, they could not deny the truth of their own eyes...

430.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_004020_RUNAR
430.description: The sunless sea of heaven, full of love and grace, where none need know pain or suffering.

431.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_004030_RUNAR
431.description: In that moment, when the sky's light began to wane, I knew our prayers had been answered.

432.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_004040_RUNAR
432.description: ...That we were doomed to face oblivion at life's end no longer.

433.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_004050_RUNAR
433.description: When first we met, I harbored certain suspicions about you. Now I see that I was right.

434.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_004060_RUNAR
434.description: You are the Bringers of Shadow. The Warriors of Darkness. The saviors for whom we have prayed for so long.

435.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_004070_YSHTOLA
435.description: I suppose you're not entirely wrong...

436.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_004080_YSHTOLA
436.description: But we are not worthy of your reverence, nor have we any desire to be worshipped. If you would pray, pray for your children, that they may one day know a better world.

437.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_004090_RUNAR
437.description: ...I will do as you say. But please, let us at least hold a feast to celebrate your victory. You deserve that much.

438.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_004100_YSHTOLA
438.description: I am sorry, Runar, but there is still much to be done, and scant time in which to do it.

439.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_004110_YSHTOLA
439.description: We must go─all of us. For we share the same path and the same fate.

440.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_004120_RUNAR
440.description: So be it. I ask only that you hold us in your hearts, as we will hold you in ours, now and ever after. By the boundless dark, this I swear.

441.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_004130_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
441.description: So there's a light sealed inside you, is there? You wouldn't know it from the outside. You look the same as you ever did to me.

443.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_A8_000_001_NONE_VOICE
443.description: I must stay the course. For the others.

444.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_A8_000_002_NONE_VOICE
444.description: And what if that changes? What if it overwhelms me?

445.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_A8_000_003_NONE_VOICE
445.description: Then I suppose there's naught to do but rest.

446.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_004140_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
446.description: True enough. Packing up and going home isn't really an option, is it. If you don't face the music here, it'll only come and find you there.

447.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_004150_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
447.description: Damned if I know. It's not as if I can lift a finger to help myself, much less you.

448.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_004160_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
448.description: Have faith in your friends. Look out for them, and hope that they look out for you. What more can you do?

449.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_004170_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
449.description: Ah, yes. If they're not asking you to fight they're telling you to rest. Which isn't to say they're wrong. You'll need your strength for what's to come.

450.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_004180_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
450.description: ...Think he was telling the truth? Emet, I mean. All that rot about Hydaelyn being no different from any other primal...

451.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_004190_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
451.description: If so, what would that make Her “blessing”? Are we just slaves to Her will?

452.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_004200_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
452.description: Ahh─let's pay him no mind. Lies are the Ascians' stock-in-trade.

453.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_004210_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
453.description: Villains, heroes─all a matter of perspective, they'd have you believe. One man's fond memory another's waking nightmare...

454.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_004220_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
454.description: Me, I'm no saint or savior─just another sinner. And I know damn well I'm in no position to judge...

455.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_004230_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
455.description: When I saw the people of Slitherbough look up at the sky and celebrate the return of the dark...felt good.

456.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_004240_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
456.description: It was moments like that that I cherished─much more than the thrill of adventure. The quiet after the storm.

457.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_004250_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
457.description: I always took comfort in that.

459.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_004270_ESTINIEN
459.description: What did the scouts have to report?

460.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_004280_SHADOWHUNTER
460.description: Several skirmishes, but nothing of consequence. The fighting seems to have taken its toll on both sides.

461.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_004290_ESTINIEN
461.description: A stalemate, then. The Alliance has done well to hold the line for so long.

462.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_004300_ESTINIEN
462.description: ...But then they did have Ishgardian reinforcements.

463.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_004310_SHADOWHUNTER
463.description: Nevertheless, neither side has any appetite for a prolonged engagement.

464.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_004320_SHADOWHUNTER
464.description: 'Tis but the calm before the storm. And should the Empire choose to bring their full might to bear...

465.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_004330_ESTINIEN
465.description: To say nothing of Black Rose.

466.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_004340_ESTINIEN
466.description: All the more reason to hasten our search. How close are your people to identifying our next target?

467.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_004350_SHADOWHUNTER
467.description: Close enough. Though I have received some troubling intelligence.

468.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_004360_SHADOWHUNTER
468.description: One of our generals posted to the Ala Mhigan front recently disappeared without trace from the battlefield at the Ghimlyt Dark.

469.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_004370_ESTINIEN
469.description: Odd. Dead seems unlikely, fled less so. I wonder where he'll turn up...

470.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_004380_SHADOWHUNTER
470.description: Were I a betting man, I would say <hex:021A020203>here<hex:021A020103>─in the capital.

471.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_004390_SHADOWHUNTER
471.description: Not that any deserter who valued his life would contemplate returning. But a corpse might, given the right encouragement.

472.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_004400_ESTINIEN
472.description: In the manner of His Royal Remains, you mean?

473.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_004410_SHADOWHUNTER
473.description: Elidibus plainly has no need of a new host, so the question becomes, who?

474.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_004420_SHADOWHUNTER
474.description: It may be that another player has joined the game.

475.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_004430_SHADOWHUNTER
475.description: Something to consider, at any rate. But come, there is work to be done.

476.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_004440_ZENOS
476.description: These bloodless games make for poor sport.

477.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_004450_ZENOS
477.description: Mayhap if Father... Nay. I am a stranger to him in this body.

478.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_004460_ZENOS
478.description: Besides, there is but one hand that can make me whole again. My enemy...my friend...

479.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_004470_ZENOS
479.description: Besides, there is but one hand that can make me whole again. My enemy...my friend...

480.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05002_004480_ZENOS
480.description: I know not what entertainment occupies you, but if you will not clear the way for me, then I shall seize the reins of fate once more.
